headline: Indian IT services showed uneven growth in Q2 FY27, with a few firms posting strong revenue gains while others saw modest or declining profit.
summary: Revenue growth ranged from sub‑2% at Infosys to over 50% at Coforge. AI‑related wins were highlighted across several companies, boosting margins for HCLTech and Mphasis. Guidance was trimmed at Infosys but raised at Coforge. Profit trends were mixed, with HCLTech and Mphasis posting double‑digit jumps and Wipro and Persistent seeing declines.

themes.title: AI‑driven revenue acceleration
themes.detail: AI contributed to higher margins and deal wins at HCLTech, Mphasis and LTM.

themes.title: Margin pressure at larger peers
themes.detail: Infosys trimmed FY27 revenue guidance and saw only 1.5% YoY growth, reflecting slower top‑line momentum.

themes.title: High‑growth mid‑size players
themes.detail: Coforge posted 53.6% YoY revenue growth and raised its EBIT margin guidance.
